title: Lost Vape Centaurus B80 AIO Pod System Kit 5ml
description:
Lost Vape Centaurus B80 AIO Pod System Kit 5ml
The Lost Vape Centaurus B80 AIO Kit, featuring a 5-80W range, Centaurus Boro Tank, and UB AIO Pod with compatibility for the UB Ultra Coils. Adopting a zinc alloy and stainless steel chassis, the Centaurus B80 AIO is well-built, resistant to light falls and drops. Powered by a single high-amp 18650 battery, the Centarus B80 AIO is designed to deliver outstanding flavor and vapor from your favorite eJuice or nicotine salts. Paired with the Centaurus Boro Tank, the Centaurus B80 can accept hand-twisted coils on the dual post build deck. Included with the B80 AIO kit is the UB AIO pod. Perfect for those that do not like building, the UB AIO Pod is compatible with the UB Ultra Coils Series, making coil changes easy and simple. Sporting magnetic panels on either side, the Centaurus B80 AIO is Lost Vape’s take on a boro mod, delivering a superior design and functionality.
Brand: Lost Vape
Unit: 1Set
Dimensions: 80.8mm by 50mm by 24.4mm
Battery Capacity: Single 18650 Battery – Not Included
Wattage Range: 5-80W
Voltage Range: 3.0-4.2V
Resistance Range: 0.15-2.0ohm
Chassis Material: Zinc-Alloy + Stainless Steel
Display: 0.42 inch OLED Screen
Charging: Type-C Port
Operation: Button-Activated
Pod Series: UB AIO Pod / Centaurus Boro Tank
Boro Tank: Dual Post Build Deck – Single Coil
Pod Capacity: 5ml
Construction: PCTG
Fill-System: Side Fill System
Coil Support: UB Ultra Coils
Coil Installation: Press Fit
Pod Connection: Press Fit
Package: Gift Box
Each set contain:
1pc Centaurus B80 AIO Device
1pc 5ml UB AIO Pod
1pc 5ml Centaurus Boro Tank
1pc 0.2ohm Ultra M7 Coil
1pc 0.15ohm Ultra M8 Coil
2pc Drip Tips
7pc Drip Tip Rings
1pc Tank Parts Pack
1pc Metal Spanner
1pc Type-C Cable
2pc User Manual
1pc Warranty Card
